## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 24 user-facing changes.
### New
- Allow Crest on Mac to request access to system passkeys and connect to the iCloud Passwords extension
### Improved
- Fade smoothly between pinned-tab outline colors as website colors become available - Reduce browsing slowdowns from Picture in Picture while still finding videos added as you browse
### Fixed
- Keep pinned-tab colors consistent when pages unload and use more representative website colors - Use favicon colors for pinned outlines when websites declare black, white, or neutral theme colors - Keep black, white, and gray favicon colors in pinned-tab outlines - Open Quick Window pages in an existing normal browser window instead of creating a duplicate - Keep password manager extensions connected while idle to avoid repeated pairing prompts - Request macOS passkey permission when you sign in on a website - Keep selected upload files accessible and explain blocked file access - Use the standard keyboard with a spacebar in the iPad command palette - Let the system handle passkey sign-in directly without an extra permission check
---
